adversarial_review.method: Every integration review re-read the charter and printed its calculated hash. Any actionable finding reset the consecutive-Clean count; timeouts and unavailable reviewers were not counted.
accepted_findings: coalesce concurrent starts before paid dispatch
persist paid receipts when strict actor results are rejected
make terminal snapshots immutable
fence execution across processes with leases and stable dispatch identity
preserve rejected worker receipts and observed spend
allowlist child-process environment variables and keep credentials out of durable state
atomically establish request identity across SQLite processes
honor cancellation before worker dispatch and prevent late terminal overwrite
freeze worker model/profile and price-snapshot applicability for claims
terminalize unavailable verifier outcomes and forbid blind verifier replay
require explicit usage availability instead of inferring measured zero
preserve Pi session and execution evidence
rejoin a successor after execution claim loss or lease renewal failure
fence expired leases and concurrent SQLite startup
bind reporter prose and fallback fields to durable verification evidence
narrow the reporter port to evidence needed for the report
bind intake-authoritative obligations into request digest and durable identity
carry canonical obligations independently into the worker port and prompt
reject legacy snapshots lacking the obligation contract before actor dispatch
construct paid receipts before rejecting provider, model, or reasoning drift
persist structurally valid rejected receipts even when their binding differs
commit the exact accepted benchmark evidence and this review ledger before declaring Done
